verses.text_urhobo: Enana uvwiẹ rẹ Isọ (kọye Idọm).
verses.text_romanized: enana uvwie re iso koye idom

verses.text_urhobo: Isọ da reyọ emetẹ ri Kenan vwọ rọvwọ. Adah rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Elọn rẹ ohwo ri Hẹt, Oholibamah rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Anah ọmọ ri Zibeọn re ohwo ri Hiv,
verses.text_romanized: iso da reyo emete ri kenan vwo rovwo adah re omote ri elon re ohwo ri het oholibamah re omote ri anah omo ri zibeon re ohwo ri hiv

verses.text_urhobo: kugbe Basʼemath, ọmọtẹ rẹ Ishmael rẹ oniọvo ri Nebaiot.
verses.text_romanized: kugbe bas'emath omote re ishmael re oniovo ri nebaiot

verses.text_urhobo: Adah de vwiẹ kẹ Isọ, Elifaz; Basʼemath de vwiẹ Roẹl;
verses.text_romanized: adah de vwie ke iso elifaz bas'emath de vwie roel

verses.text_urhobo: Oholibamah de vwiẹ Jeush, Jalam, kugbe Korah. Enana keye emọ rẹ Isọ ro vwiẹri vwẹ otọ ri Kenan.
verses.text_romanized: oholibamah de vwie jeush jalam kugbe korah enana keye emo re iso ro vwieri vwe oto ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Isọ da reyọ eya rọye, te emọ rọye rẹ emeshare vẹ emetẹ kugbe ekru rọye ejobi, uchuru rọye, te eranvwe rọye, kugbe eyere rọye ejobi ro vwori vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, ọ da kua kpo otọ ọfa ro tephe kẹ oniọvo rọye Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin iso da reyo eya roye te emo roye re emeshare ve emete kugbe ekru roye ejobi uchuru roye te eranvwe roye kugbe eyere roye ejobi ro vwori vwe oto ri kenan o da kua kpo oto ofa ro tephe ke oniovo roye jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Fikiridie ayen vwo eyere buebu gangan o rhe jẹn ayen yeri kugbee, otọ na sa gba aye-en kidie uchuru rayen bunọ.
verses.text_romanized: fikiridie ayen vwo eyere buebu gangan o rhe jen ayen yeri kugbee oto na sa gba aye en kidie uchuru rayen buno

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Isọ da dia orere rọ enu rẹ ugbenu ri Seir; Isọ na kọye Idọm.
verses.text_romanized: koye iso da dia orere ro enu re ugbenu ri seir iso na koye idom

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye uvwiẹ rẹ Isọ ọsẹ rẹ Idọm vwẹ obo orere rẹ ugbenu ri Seir.
verses.text_romanized: enana keye uvwie re iso ose re idom vwe obo orere re ugbenu ri seir

verses.text_urhobo: Enana odẹ rẹ emọ rẹ Isọ. Elifaz rẹ ọmọ rẹ Adah rẹ aye rẹ Isọ, Roẹl rẹ ọmọ ri Basʼemath rẹ aye rẹ Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: enana ode re emo re iso elifaz re omo re adah re aye re iso roel re omo ri bas'emath re aye re iso

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Elifaz kẹ Timan, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, kugbe Kenaz.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri elifaz ke timan omar zefo gatam kugbe kenaz

verses.text_urhobo: (Timna ọye ọsẹ rẹ Elifaz, ọmọ rẹ Isọ; o de vwiẹ Amalẹk kẹ Elifaz).
verses.text_romanized: timna oye ose re elifaz omo re iso o de vwie amalek ke elifaz

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Roẹl: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, kugbe Mizzah. Enana keye emọ ri Basʼemath, aye re Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri roel nahath zerah shammah kugbe mizzah enana keye emo ri bas'emath aye re iso

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ rẹ Oholibamah ọmọtẹ rẹ Anah rẹ ọmọ ri Zibeọn, aye rẹ Isọ: o de vwiẹ Jeush, Jalam kugbe Korah kẹ Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo re oholibamah omote re anah re omo ri zibeon aye re iso o de vwie jeush jalam kugbe korah ke iso

verses.text_urhobo: Enana eye ilori rẹ emọ rẹ Isọ. Emọ rẹ Elifaz rẹ ọwanra rẹ Isọ: ilori na ke ena; Timan, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,
verses.text_romanized: enana eye ilori re emo re iso emo re elifaz re owanra re iso ilori na ke ena timan omar zefo kenaz

verses.text_urhobo: Korah, Gatam, kugbe Amalẹk; enana keye ilori rẹ emọ rẹ Elifaz vwẹ otọ rẹ Idọm; keye emọ rẹ Adah.
verses.text_romanized: korah gatam kugbe amalek enana keye ilori re emo re elifaz vwe oto re idom keye emo re adah

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Roẹl, ọmọ rẹ Isọ: ilori rọye kẹ Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, kugbe Mizzah; enana keye ilori ri Roẹl vwẹ otọ rẹ Idọm; ayen kẹ emọ ri Basʼemath, aye rẹ Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri roel omo re iso ilori roye ke nahath zerah shammah kugbe mizzah enana keye ilori ri roel vwe oto re idom ayen ke emo ri bas'emath aye re iso

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ rẹ Oholibamah, aye rẹ Isọ: ilori rọye kẹ ena Jeush, Jalam, kugbe Korah, enana keye ilori rẹ Oholibamah, rẹ ọmọtẹ rẹ Anah, rẹ aye rẹ Isọ.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo re oholibamah aye re iso ilori roye ke ena jeush jalam kugbe korah enana keye ilori re oholibamah re omote re anah re aye re iso

verses.text_urhobo: Enana eye emọ rẹ Isọ (kọye Idọm), enana keye ilori rayen.
verses.text_romanized: enana eye emo re iso koye idom enana keye ilori rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Seir ohwo ri Họr, ri yere otọ na vẹrhe: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeọn, Anah,
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri seir ohwo ri hor ri yere oto na verhe lotan shobal zibeon anah

verses.text_urhobo: Dishon, Ezer, kugbe Dishan; enana ilori rẹ emọ ri Họr, rẹ emọ ri Sier vwẹ otọ rẹ Idọm.
verses.text_romanized: dishon ezer kugbe dishan enana ilori re emo ri hor re emo ri sier vwe oto re idom

verses.text_urhobo: Emọ ri Lotan ki Hori kugbe Heman, oniọvo rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Lotan ki Timna.
verses.text_romanized: emo ri lotan ki hori kugbe heman oniovo re omote ri lotan ki timna

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye emọ ri Shobal Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefo kugbe Onam.
verses.text_romanized: enana keye emo ri shobal alvan manahath ebal shefo kugbe onam

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Zibeọn, Ajah kugbe Anah, ọye Anah rọ mrẹ ogbugbu re tuabọ vwẹ evun rẹ aton na, rọ vwọ sẹro rẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ ri Zibeọn rẹ ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri zibeon ajah kugbe anah oye anah ro mre ogbugbu re tuabo vwe evun re aton na ro vwo sero re eketekete ri zibeon re ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ rẹ Anah Dishon kugbe Oholibamah rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Anah.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo re anah dishon kugbe oholibamah re omote ri anah

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, kugbe Cheran.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri dishon hemdan eshban ithran kugbe cheran

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ rẹ Ezer. Bilhan, Zaavan, kugbe Akan.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo re ezer bilhan zaavan kugbe akan

verses.text_urhobo: Enana emọ ri Dishan Uz kugbe Aran.
verses.text_romanized: enana emo ri dishan uz kugbe aran

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye ilori rẹ emọ ri Họr: ilori na kẹ ena Lotan, Shobal, Zibeọn, Anah,
verses.text_romanized: enana keye ilori re emo ri hor ilori na ke ena lotan shobal zibeon anah

verses.text_urhobo: Dishon, Ezer, kugbe Dishan, ena keye ilori rẹ emọ ri Họr, dohwo dẹgborho rọye vwẹ otọ ri Seir.
verses.text_romanized: dishon ezer kugbe dishan ena keye ilori re emo ri hor dohwo degborho roye vwe oto ri seir

verses.text_urhobo: Enana ke rha ivie re rere vwẹ otọ rẹ Idọm, tavwe ra ke mrẹ ne ovie rere vwe Izrẹl.
verses.text_romanized: enana ke rha ivie re rere vwe oto re idom tavwe ra ke mre ne ovie rere vwe izrel

verses.text_urhobo: Bẹla rẹ ọmọ ri Beor da re vwẹ Idọm, odẹ rẹ orere rọ da re ki Dinhabath.
verses.text_romanized: bela re omo ri beor da re vwe idom ode re orere ro da re ki dinhabath

verses.text_urhobo: Bẹla de ghwu, Jobab rẹ ọmọ ri Zerah re ohwo ri Bozrah da re vwe asan ro nuru.
verses.text_romanized: bela de ghwu jobab re omo ri zerah re ohwo ri bozrah da re vwe asan ro nuru

verses.text_urhobo: Jobab de ghwu, Husham rẹ ohwo rẹ otọ ri Teman da re vwẹ asan ro nuru.
verses.text_romanized: jobab de ghwu husham re ohwo re oto ri teman da re vwe asan ro nuru

verses.text_urhobo: Husham de ghwu, Hadad rẹ ọmọ ri Bedad, ro phi Midian kua vwẹ otọ ri Moab na, da re vwẹ asan ro nuru, odẹ rẹ orere rọye kẹ Avit.
verses.text_romanized: husham de ghwu hadad re omo ri bedad ro phi midian kua vwe oto ri moab na da re vwe asan ro nuru ode re orere roye ke avit

verses.text_urhobo: Hada de ghwu, Samlah ri Masreʼkah da re vwẹ asan ro nuru.
verses.text_romanized: hada de ghwu samlah ri masre'kah da re vwe asan ro nuru

verses.text_urhobo: Samlah de ghwu, Shaul ri Rehoʼboth rọ dia oma rẹ urhie ri Yufretis da re vwẹ asan ro nuru.
verses.text_romanized: samlah de ghwu shaul ri reho'both ro dia oma re urhie ri yufretis da re vwe asan ro nuru

verses.text_urhobo: Shaul de ghwu, Baal-hanan rẹ ọmọ rẹ Akbor da re vwe asan ro nuru.
verses.text_romanized: shaul de ghwu baal hanan re omo re akbor da re vwe asan ro nuru

verses.text_urhobo: Baal-hanan rẹ ọmọ rẹ Akbor de ghwu, Hadar da re vwe asan ro nuru, odẹ rẹ orere rọye ki Pau; odẹ rẹ aye rọye ki Mẹhẹtabẹl, rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Matred, ọmọtẹ ri Mezhab.
verses.text_romanized: baal hanan re omo re akbor de ghwu hadar da re vwe asan ro nuru ode re orere roye ki pau ode re aye roye ki mehetabel re omote ri matred omote ri mezhab

verses.text_urhobo: Enana keye ẹdẹ ri ilori rẹ emọ rẹ Isọ, uvwiuvwiẹ rayen kugbe irere rayen dia vẹ odẹ rayen ilori na kẹ ena: Timna, Alvah, Jetet,
verses.text_romanized: enana keye ede ri ilori re emo re iso uvwiuvwie rayen kugbe irere rayen dia ve ode rayen ilori na ke ena timna alvah jetet

verses.text_urhobo: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
verses.text_romanized: oholibamah elah pinon

verses.text_urhobo: Kenaz, Temna, Mibzar,
verses.text_romanized: kenaz temna mibzar

verses.text_urhobo: Magdiel, kugbe Iram; enana ilori re Idọm (kọye Isọ, ọsẹ rẹ Idọm), vẹ asansan rayen dia vwẹ otọ rayen kuara na.
verses.text_romanized: magdiel kugbe iram enana ilori re idom koye iso ose re idom ve asansan rayen dia vwe oto rayen kuara na
